cases.sentence: Иосиф пошел к ___ и сказал ему.
cases.translation: Joseph went to Pharaoh and said to him.
cases.explain: The preposition к indicating direction toward a person takes the dative case.

cases.translation: They came out of the land of Canaan.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он выбрал пятерых из ___ и представил их фараону.
cases.translation: He chose five of his brothers and presented them to Pharaoh.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from among) governs the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Посели отца и братьев в лучшей ___ этой земли.
cases.translation: Settle your father and brothers in the best part of this land.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Иаков благословил фараона и покинул его ___.
cases.translation: Jacob blessed Pharaoh and left his palace.
cases.explain: The transitive verb покинуть takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иосиф собрал все ___, какие только были в Египте.
cases.translation: Joseph gathered all the money that was in Egypt.
cases.explain: The transitive verb собрать takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Дай нам ___, зачем нам умирать у тебя на глазах.
cases.translation: Give us bread, why should we die before your eyes.
cases.explain: The partitive object of дать (some bread) takes the genitive case.

cases.translation: The land became the property of Pharaoh.
cases.explain: The predicate noun after стать (to become) stands in the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Он выбрал пятерых из братьев и представил их фараону.
reading.question: How many brothers did Joseph present to Pharaoh?
reading.explain: The text says he chose 'пятерых из братьев' (five of the brothers).

reading.question: What did Pharaoh ask Jacob?
reading.explain: Pharaoh asks 'Сколько тебе лет?' (how old are you?).

reading.ru: Иаков благословил фараона и покинул его дворец.
reading.question: What did Jacob do before leaving Pharaoh's palace?
reading.explain: The text says 'Иаков благословил фараона' (Jacob blessed Pharaoh).

reading.ru: Так Иосиф купил всю землю в Египте для фараона.
reading.question: What did Joseph buy for Pharaoh?
reading.explain: The text says Joseph bought 'всю землю в Египте для фараона' (all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh).

reading.ru: Иаков прожил в Египте 17 лет, так что всего он жил 147 лет.
reading.question: How many years did Jacob live in Egypt?
reading.explain: The text says Jacob lived 17 years in Egypt, and 147 years in total.

reading.ru: Иосиф поклялся ему, и Израиль поклонился Богу, оперевшись на свой посох.
reading.question: What did Israel do after Joseph swore to him?
options: He bowed to God, leaning on his staff
reading.correct: He bowed to God, leaning on his staff
reading.explain: The text says Israel bowed to God 'оперевшись на свой посох' (leaning on his staff).
